lessons: Title block: 設計名称 '新田豊島橋(仮称)実施設計', 図面名称 '補剛桁(その1-1)', 縮尺 '図示', 図面番号 'J-57' is the rightmost cell. The sheet title also reads S=1:30 near the top.

Box girder end block (A-A): flange width 1700 overall (1600 between webs plus 50 overhang each side). Depth 3038 = 32 bottom flange + 2976 web + 30 top flange (the 12 mm dimension is the deck/flange joint detail). Web spacing is 1600.

Top flange plates are 1700x30 (SM490YB) with a 1700x16x1588 (SM490YA) end piece. Bottom flange plates are 1700x32 (SM490YB). Each flange carries 2 longitudinal ribs of PL 230x25 (SM490YB), at 533/534/533 spacing across the 1600 width.
Webs are 2-WEB PL 2976x18 (SM490YB). The horizontal stiffeners (web ribs) are PL 190x19 or 195x19, and no material is stated for them, so the note 'unlabelled material = SM400A' applies.
Overall girder length is 104100 and span length 102700. The end block is a segment of about 4225 member length, and drawing lengths like 4579 and 4305 are web plate lengths per panel.
The sheet is a plan/elevation/detail composite. Read plate sizes from the callout text (N-PL WxTxL (material)), and take the section depth from the dimension string on A-A and the elevation.
